title: The Worm Plate
tagline: A worm on a dish with a real brain: four brains, from two wires to the full C. elegans connectome, then an evolving population, then the argument about whether anyone is home.
readinessNote: A simulation and debate toy, not a game: five tabs you watch and poke (add lights, tap a worm, cut cells, move the toxic patch, switch the predator on). There is no goal or score. Each tab is a hand-written object in src/app.js.
buildYourOwn: A new tab (another brain or experiment), new mutation kinds on the evolution plate, new stimuli, another lens in the debate.
